title: Rongmei Hymnal
summary: An installable, offline-first digital library that brings 1,271 songs from three Rongmei and community hymn collections into one searchable, accessible reading space.

sections.label: Purpose
sections.title: A digital home for songs carried by community memory.
paragraphs: Rongmei Hymnal gathers multiple songbooks without flattening their individual identity. Credits, sources, editorial notes, and rights information stay connected to each collection.
The interface is designed for worship, learning, community singing, and long-term digital access on phones, tablets, and computers.

sections.label: Collection
sections.title: Three collections, 1,271 searchable songs.
points: Hymdaihlu: 930 songs imported from a legacy SQLite source
VBS Songs: 36 public-domain or traditional English selections
JSON metadata and schema files keep the library structure explicit

sections.label: Experience
sections.title: Built for focused reading and unreliable connectivity.
points: Adjust the reading layout and use presentation mode
Save favourites, history, and reading preferences on the device
Install as a PWA and explicitly download the library for offline use
Refresh downloaded content when a newer collection version is detected

sections.label: Stewardship
sections.title: Software openness with careful content boundaries.
paragraphs: The Apache 2.0 license applies to the software, interface, tools, and documentation. Lyrics, editions, arrangements, cover art, and other collection content retain their respective rights and attribution requirements.

architecture.title: Rongmei Hymnal architecture and data model
architecture.summary: A static PWA architecture separates the application shell, book registry, per-book metadata, song data, local preferences, and explicit offline downloads.
steps: index.html, book.html, and hymn.html provide library, collection, and focused-reading views styled by css/main.css.
data/songbooks/index.json registers each collection with its directory, metadata path, version, and song count.
JSON schemas document expected song and metadata shapes; individual collections retain their own source, editorial, credit, and rights records.
JavaScript modules divide application startup, data access, rendering, settings, local history/favourites, contact information, and offline storage responsibilities.
The service worker caches the app shell; an explicit download workflow saves selected library data and reports storage progress and status.
Version comparison refreshes downloaded content when the app reconnects and newer book metadata is available.

validation.title: Rongmei Hymnal release checklist
validation.summary: A validation checklist derived from the repository's schemas, versioned book registry, offline workflow, reading interface, and content-rights boundary.
checks: Confirm each registered book directory, metadata file, version, and song count agrees with data/songbooks/index.json.
Validate song and book records against schemas/songs.schema.json and schemas/book-metadata.schema.json.
Test search, focused reading, font settings, favourites, history, and presentation mode on phone and desktop widths.
Install from HTTPS, complete an offline download, disconnect the network, and reopen previously downloaded collections.
Reconnect after increasing a book version and verify the application detects and refreshes changed library data.
Review credits, source notes, editorial status, and rights metadata before publishing any new collection.

pageNote: This page combines the project overview, architecture, usage, validation, safety boundaries, status, and source links in one case study.
